messages:
maria_g: Quick heads-up — launch post (EMEA) drove a big spike in clicks this morning but MQLs in the dashboard didn't budge. GA shows conversions, SFDC doesn't. Anyone else see a mismatch?

samir: saw same. GA -> click events up ~3x vs baseline. but `utm_campaign` shows some weird truncation on a handful of URLs. suspect tracking template.

josh: i'm pulling the inbound-routing logs now. quick check: are we funneling via the wp redirect or direct landing? that matters for UTM passthrough.

maria_g: WP redirect. we used the shortlink for post. thought the redirect kept UTM but maybe not for `?utm_source`

elaine: can we get a cohort split by entry page + ad or organic? want to see if this is concentrated to the linkedin posts vs newsletter.

josh: running query on routing service: `select count(*) from hits where utm_campaign is null and ref like '%l.linkedin%'` — preliminary shows ~480 hits with utm lost, mostly shortlink path `/r/xyz`.

samir: ok that's the likely culprit. shortcut: re-add `?` passthrough to the redirector and update the shortlink config. ops-bot, can you queue a redirect change to preserve query string for 1 hour window?

ops-bot: deploy job queued: `redirector-update-preserve-query` — ETA ~18m. will post status.

maria_g: thanks — if deploy finishes, can we reprocess the last 6h of click events to regenerate MQL attribution? if not we should note in today's KPI review that launch post clicks are inflated vs attributed leads.

elaine: agree — i'll add a line to the weekly KPI deck: 'Launch post tracking gap — 480 sessions with lost UTMs, reprocessing pending'.

josh: FYI reprocessing note: we can backfill by joining server logs to shortlink click table using `click_id` but it won't be 100% — estimate ~70% recoverable.

samir: i'll coordinate with ops on the backfill and post an ETA once I have it.

maria_g: perfect. thanks team. once backfill done, can we rerun the dashboard viz? if not i'll flag traffic vs MQL inconsistency in the readout.

ops-bot: deploy completed successfully. redirector updated to preserve query strings. backfill ticket created #2584.

samir: created backfill PR and scheduled job for 02:00 UTC. will update #2584 with results.

elaine: added slide to KPI deck, note + suggested wording. done.

maria_g: closing loop — appreciate the quick turnaround :raised_hands:
